description: This file implements utility functions for handling URL request redirects, including updating HTTP request headers during redirects, retrieving referrer policies, and synthesizing redirect headers with CORS considerations.

methods.name: UpdateHttpRequest
methods.description: Updates HTTP request headers during a redirect, handling header removal, method change, origin header adjustments, and merging modified headers.

methods.name: GetReferrerPolicyHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the 'Referrer-Policy' header from HTTP response headers if present.

methods.name: SynthesizeRedirectHeaders
methods.description: Creates synthetic HTTP response headers for a redirect, including CORS headers if the request originated from a different origin.
